purpose: The GET route open_login_session navigates LoginCapability's page to immediately after creation, before polling for logged-in markers.
notes: docs/recovery/PORTAL_CONTRACT.md §2 attests only a logged-out-state detection HEURISTIC (URL contains 'login'; markers input[name='login']/#login/#password/expert_.phtml) -- it does NOT attest a concrete navigable login page path on the real portal. '/SinAuto_MCMA/login' is an INC-06 mock-only convention for offline/CI testing. mcma.portal.capabilities never hardcodes this path: open_login_session requires the caller to supply exactly one reviewed GET contract with capability='auth' and operation_type='login_page' in its policy, and navigates to whatever route that contract names -- a real deployment must supply its own confirmed contract before any live navigation.
